messages:
anya: Quick sync — Spark Compute EAP kickoff. NDA signed last night, they want a compatibility + microbench pass next week. Who can take the initial matrix?

mike: I'm available. Can we get registry creds + container image?

anya: Spark said they'll push a private image and provide S3 creds. I'll DM the legal redacted NDA highlights — note: no public numbers until joint approval.

olivia: What model variants are we running? HF/Redwood 7B/13B? Any quant targets?

raj: Proposal: 7B + 13B baseline. Test int8 and int4 if runtime supports it. Perf + correctness on our eval subset. Baseline comparison on a standard g4dn.xlarge run for cost parity.

spark-eng: We'll publish the image to a private registry and create a role for redwood-eap. Registry URL + role ARN by EOD.

kevin: Bench plan draft: 100 warmup tokens, 1k token generation per prompt, measure p50/p95/p99 latency + tokens/sec. Batch sizes 1,4,8. Log artifacts to bench-bot and S3. Also capture peak memory.

bench-bot: Benchmark job queued: id=4821, runner=spark-eap-nodepool-3, ETA ~2h.

mike: Quick question on KV cache persistence — we need seq_len=2048 runs. Also 13B int4 might OOM on 48GB if tensor remap not enabled. Any recommended env flags?

spark-eng: 48GB HBM nodes are available. For 13B int4 set SPARK_QUANT=1 and use the quant-runtime image tag `spark/rt:quant-2026-11`. We'll include a small startup script.

raj: Olivia — please share a 100-prompt representative eval set (no customer PHI) so we can do correctness checks.

olivia: Uploading now: https://drive.redwood.com/spark-eap/seed_prompts.txt (access: redwood-eap@redwood.com).

anya: Action items: kevin run bench matrix and post logs, mike validate correctness + OOM tests, raj coordinate model packaging + PR, olivia share eval (done), spark-eng push creds. Target: initial results by Tue 2026-03-31. @kevin can you set a reminder?

kevin: :thumbsup: Kicking off tonight, will post logs. bench-bot please post a summary to #partnerships when job completes.

bench-bot: Job 4821 completed. Summary: 7B-int8 p50=85ms p95=220ms p99=450ms (batch=1). 13B-int4 p50=210ms p95=420ms p99=890ms (batch=1). Best throughput observed: 6 tok/s at batch=4 for 13B-int4. Full logs: https://logs.redwood.com/jobs/4821 (s3://redwood-eap/4821/)

anya: Nice initial numbers. We'll extract detailed breakdowns (compute vs io vs memcpy) and decide micro-optimizations to try: KV prefetch, fused attention kernels, and reduced batch padding. Reminder: partner requested non-attribution internal results only. Do not publish.

spark-eng: Roger. We'll review and sync on Thurs 10am PT. Invite sent to core EAP leads.

raj: I'll open a PR with quant config updates (int4 fallback flags + batch tuning) and tag @kevin @mike for review.

mike: If anyone hits OOM, try SPARK_BATCH=2 and disable tensor remapping (ENV SPARK_TENSOR_REMAP=0). Also log dmesg for GPU OOM traces.

olivia: Added test matrix spreadsheet and permissions: https://sheets.redwood.com/spark-eap/matrix (edit: partnerships_team@).

anya: Great work team — I'll draft a one-pager summarizing scope, NDA constraints, metrics to report, and next steps for the partnership PMs.

kevin: I'll paste the raw CSV and a quick plot once I scrub PII.

bench-bot: Note: next queued job for spark-eap is 4822 (optimizations sweep).

anya: Thanks all — keep updates short in this thread. We'll escalate any showstoppers to legal/eng-sre immediately.
